subject: Petition for remediation credit — FinLytics sustained tail latency (Dec 16-18)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@finlytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: FinLytics Billing <billing@finlytics.com>, ops@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-12-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Increased tail latency impacting live inference (Dec 16)

Alex —

We started seeing elevated tail latency on our production endpoints around 02:30 UTC this morning. Our monitoring shows 95th/99th percentile spikes for requests routed to the named model that lasted ~28 hours, peaking at ~1.1s above our SLA threshold. This caused visible slowdowns in our customer-facing flows and a handful of queued timeouts on downstream services.

Can Redwood confirm root cause and provide a proposed remediation/financial concession for the affected billing window? Our billing contact (cc'd) has asked for a formal ask to expedite reconciliation.

Attached: short CSV with request samples and timestamps.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform
FinLytics

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@finlytics.com>
Cc: FinLytics Billing <billing@finlytics.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-16T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Increased tail latency impacting live inference (Dec 16)

Alicia — thank you for the heads up and for the sample CSV. I'm very sorry for the interruption. We have a triage team looking at the window you called out.

Short update / next steps:
- We've identified an autoscaler interaction that appears to have created bursty queuing under a narrow request-size distribution; engineering is on a patch and we've applied mitigations to new allocations.
- I'll follow up with a full RCA and timeline (target EOD tomorrow).
- On the remediation/concession: we typically do pro-rated credits per impact window, but FinLytics' usage and the sustained nature here merits an exec-approved one-off offer. I'm proposing we provisionally offer either a pro-rated 25% credit for the affected invoice or a single platform month credit, whichever is larger, capped at $40k. I need exec sign-off to finalize.

I've attached an incident summary and forwarded the ops CSV to Dev for technical detail. Marissa / Karthik — can you review and advise if we can approve this level of concession? If you prefer a dollar figure instead of a percent, I'm happy to translate with finance.

Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: -
Date: 2026-12-16T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Increased tail latency impacting live inference (Dec 16)

Quick technical note (summary for approval thread):
- Root cause: a race in the delayed scale-down path combined with certain request-size skew produced sustained KV-cache warmups that increased scheduling variance (~02:25 UTC start).
- Mitigation applied: forced rebalance + hot-cache seeding; patch to autoscaler queued for hotfix (deployed 2026-12-16T13:20 PST).
- Impact scope: ~28h window, ~18% of FinLytics' token volume for the billing cycle was routed to affected backends during the window.

Suggested credit calc options (for approval):
1) Pro-rated token-weighted credit = 25% of Dec invoice for tokens served during the window (estimate: ~$34.2k).
2) One-month platform credit (FinLytics' current monthly run-rate = ~$38k) — full month credit would be larger (~$38k).

If the ask is for a capped offer, recommend: "greater of (1) or (2) up to $40k" — that gives good customer goodwill while bounding spend.

Attaching: slo_window_20261216-18.csv and timeline.txt (ops extracts).

— Dev
Senior Production Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com

Request for sign-off: authorize a remediation concession for FinLytics as described below:
- Option A (preferred): One month platform credit (value = their monthly run-rate) OR pro-rated token-weighted 25% credit for the affected invoice, whichever is larger.
- Limit: cap the concession at $40,000 total.
- Conditions: customer signs a short acceptance of the RCA and agrees to join our proactive onboarding session for resilience tuning (we'll schedule).

Alex, Dev — please prepare the customer-facing concession letter and invoice memo to send to billing once Karthik signs off. Karthik — can you confirm the cap/approval?

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
